svg.title: When a server needs more input, it returns input_required and the client retries with your answer
svg.desc: 1. The MCP client sends tools/call for get_forecast with city Lagos. 2. The weather server cannot tell which Lagos is meant, so instead of a forecast it returns resultType input_required with an elicitation asking which Lagos. 3. The host shows you the question: Lagos, Nigeria or Lagos, Portugal. 4. You choose Lagos, Nigeria. 5. The client sends tools/call again as a new request, adding your answer in inputResponses. 6. The server returns resultType complete with the forecast for Lagos, Nigeria.
